Executive Summary of Micro-Environmental and Epidemiological Indicators

Source: R/summary_executive.R
d4h_executive_summary.Rd

Generates a comprehensive executive report for a given raster layer or multi-band mosaic. It extracts key statistical moments, spatial extent and resolution metrics, Tukey outlier diagnostics, domain-specific bio-physical/epidemiological stratum interpretations, either globally (by = "general") or per territorial grid cell (by = "grid"), and optionally exports a formatted multi-sheet Excel spreadsheet.

Usage

d4h_executive_summary(
  raster_in,
  by = c("general", "grid"),
  grid = NULL,
  houses_risk = NULL,
  cell_size = 50,
  square = TRUE,
  out_xlsx = NULL,
  sample_size = 1e+06,
  digits = 3
)

d4h_report(
  raster_in,
  by = c("general", "grid"),
  grid = NULL,
  houses_risk = NULL,
  cell_size = 50,
  square = TRUE,
  out_xlsx = NULL,
  sample_size = 1e+06,
  digits = 3
)

Arguments

raster_in

SpatRaster, list of SpatRaster layers, or character file path.

by

Character. Summary aggregation scope: "general" (default, overall scene report) or "grid" (zonal summary per grid cell, with one row per cell).

grid

Optional SpatVector, sf, or character path to existing grid polygon boundaries when by = "grid". If NULL, automatically generated using cell_size and square.

houses_risk

Optional sf or data.frame of residential dwellings with calculated distance to water and risk scores (e.g. from d4h_distance_to_water or buffer analysis). If provided, appends dedicated household distance and epidemiological risk sheets to the Excel workbook.

cell_size

Numeric. Grid cell size / diameter in meters when generating a new grid for by = "grid" (default: 50).

square

Logical. If TRUE, square grid; if FALSE, hexagonal grid (default: TRUE).

out_xlsx

Character (optional). File path to export a structured multi-sheet Excel workbook (.xlsx). Default: NULL.

sample_size

Integer. Maximum number of sampled pixels for quantile and outlier analysis on large rasters (default: 1000000).

digits

Integer. Number of decimal places to format numerical metrics (default: 3).

Value

An object of class d4h_executive_summary (for by = "general") or d4h_grid_summary / data.frame (for by = "grid") containing structured metrics, spatial coverage metadata, outlier diagnostics, and thematic stratum distributions.

Details

The executive summary computes descriptive moments (mean, standard deviation, coefficient of variation, median, interquartile range) and identifies spatial anomalies using Tukey's IQR outlier fences: $$\text{Lower Fence} = Q_{25} - 1.5 \times \text{IQR}$$ $$\text{Upper Fence} = Q_{75} + 1.5 \times \text{IQR}$$ Surface strata are categorized by biophysical domain thresholds and translated into percentage and hectare metrics. When by = "grid", each row represents an operational surveillance grid cell with full descriptive moments, Tukey outlier rates, and stratum area percentages.

References

Tukey, J. W. (1977). Exploratory Data Analysis. Addison-Wesley.

Examples

# \donttest{
if (interactive()) {
  library(drones4health)
  library(terra)

  # Load raster indicator
  ndvi_file <- system.file("extdata", "ndvi.tif", package = "drones4health")

  # 1. Generate general executive report with outlier diagnostics
  exec_rep <- d4h_executive_summary(
    raster_in   = ndvi_file,
    by          = "general",
    out_xlsx    = tempfile(fileext = ".xlsx"),
    sample_size = 1000000,
    digits      = 3
  )
  print(exec_rep)

  # 2. Generate zonal grid executive summary per hexagonal cell
  exec_grid <- d4h_executive_summary(
    raster_in   = ndvi_file,
    by          = "grid",
    cell_size   = 50,
    square      = FALSE,
    out_xlsx    = tempfile(fileext = ".xlsx"),
    sample_size = 1000000,
    digits      = 3
  )
  head(exec_grid)
}
# }
